description:
Java SDK for the ARA temporal ML feature store.
      Mirrors the Python ARAStore API: write(), getLatest(), getSnapshot(),
      writeBatch(), getSnapshotBatch().  Uses the same FlatBuffers/TCP wire
      protocol (AddFeatureBatchV2 + GetFeatureBatchAsOf) and FNV-1a VP routing
      as the Python and C++ implementations.
